_comment: Phase-4 D18/F09: Thud phase/attack mover-VM FSM -- resolved NEGATIVE. The pool actor is parked in program #19 for the entire fight-anchor movie; the 0x800777xx block is a SHARED ambient program bank, not a Thud attack FSM. Offline sections regenerate: tools/phase4_d18_thud_vm_fsm.py --write; verify: --check. Live sections carry provenance below.

LIVE_IDLE_WATCH_2026-08-03.scope: isolated Interpreter-forced instance /tmp/dsrepro-d18-20260803 port 23702, pristine disc; thud_boss_movie.movie.sav (poll+watch, no movie replay)
LIVE_IDLE_WATCH_2026-08-03.result: 600 idle frames: IP oscillates 0x800777A4<->0x800777A6 (park loop, one VM step per ~5 frames); SOLE writer of +0x70 = 0x8004C834 'sw s1,0x70(s0)' inside the VM interpreter (120/120 writes). No external program switch.

LIVE_PROGRAM_POKES_2026-08-03.method: per program: fresh loadState, poke +0x70 = entry, advance 240 frames, read IP residency + XYZ delta

p21_gated_wander.note: IP rests at park_arrive_test -- the wander loop is GATED on an arrival condition

LIVE_DEFEAT_2026-08-03.method: poke HP(+0x6E)=0, watch +0x70 and +0x6E (guest writes) over 180 frames
LIVE_DEFEAT_2026-08-03.result: ZERO guest writes to +0x70 or +0x6E after the poke; flags 0x4055->0x0055 (active bit 0x4000 cleared), live table slot 0 (0x80090748) zeroed. Retirement is immediate -- NO death/defeat VM program switch exists for this actor. Reproduces phase3_thud.json's retire rule.

LIVE_PROXIMITY_NEGATIVE_2026-08-03.method: teleport Flik (0x800A6504) to 3000 units from Thud, watch +0x70 and +0x5C over 360 frames
LIVE_PROXIMITY_NEGATIVE_2026-08-03.result: No program switch (park loop only). Flags churn per tick between 0x54/0x55/0x4054/0x4055 by writers 0x8004D270 (clears), 0x80024E58 / 0x8004D38C (restore) -- a per-tick clear/set cycle, not an aggro response.

FIGHT_REPLAY_POLL_ONLY_2026-08-03.method: movie.load + movie.startPlayback(load_start_state:true) of thud_boss_movie.movie.json (4113 frames, CachedInterpreter-era -- POLL ONLY per project law, zero instrumentation armed); read slot-0 record every 30 frames to movie end

hit_and_defeat_events.observation: transient HP 50->48 for ONE 30-frame sample, restored to 50 by the next -- a landed hit (-2, matching E14's committed -2-per-hit KO-memory law) whose damage is immediately RESTORED by the fight lane
HP written to 0 outright (48 never reappears); flags/id still 0x4055/36 at that sample -- the fight lane KILLS the pool actor through the generic HP-retire path at fight end

FIGHT_REPLAY_POLL_ONLY_2026-08-03.result: Across the ENTIRE operator fight movie: the VM IP never leaves the program-#19 park loop (only 0x800777A4/0x800777A6 in 138 samples) -- including through the landed hit and through the actor's own death. Pool HP is used by the fight lane as a transient hit latch (-2 then restored) and finally zeroed to trigger generic retirement.
caveats: 30-frame sampling: hits whose -2 dip is restored faster than the cadence would be missed; one dip was caught, the committed fight law says 8 perched hits

the HP restore writer and the final HP=0 writer are UNATTRIBUTED (CachedInterpreter movie cannot be instrumented) -- named reopener, needs a re-recorded Interpreter fight movie (same item E11 already requests)

CONCLUSION.fsm_verdict: NEGATIVE, bounded, and stronger than initially stated: Thud's phase/attack behavior is NOT a mover-VM program FSM on the pool actor -- the IP stays in the parked program THROUGH a landed hit and through the actor's own death. The 0x800777xx block is a shared ambient bank (parked/two-clip/gated-wander/wander/path; census join ids 21,7,15,22,18). The fight lane (overlay, LEVEL04/LEVEL1.BIN canon + perched-hit law) uses pool HP as a transient -2 hit latch it restores, then zeroes it at fight end to retire via the generic path. Correction landed same-day: an initial 'HP never changes during the movie' summary was WRONG -- the test gate caught it against the saved timeline.

row_address_correction.claim: D18/F09's 0x800777A6 is NOT a program entry: it is the jump_back instruction inside program #19 (0x80077798, parked idle). phase3_thud.json recorded it as Thud's LIVE VM IP (boss_identity.mover_vm_ip_at_0x70) and the rows transcribed the IP as if it were a program.
